prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset: complete eight-frame Laborer dwarf walking animation strip, four columns and two rows, on real transparent alpha. Reference1 is a physical whole-body animation guide, not final artwork: follow its connected limbs and boot placement in every numbered cell. Reference2 supplies the canonical Laborer identity/costume/material; it deliberately excludes legs to avoid repeating the old faulty gait. Render one consistent stocky bald dwarf with a brown beard, cream rolled sleeves, worn brown leather waistcoat with waist belt and paneled hem, olive-grey trousers, heavy brown buckled leather boots. Same detailed semi-realistic rendering as reference2, same rear-left elevated three-quarter camera, looking and moving toward upper-left throughout. Keep the same head/torso size and pelvic center in all eight cells; exact four-by-two layout, complete uncut body in every cell, modest bob only. The near anatomical LEFT leg/arm is orange in the guide; the far anatomical RIGHT leg/arm is blue. These colors and all diagram marks must be absent from final art.
Top0: far RIGHT heel leads, near LEFT trailing toe supports with raised heel; near LEFT arm forward, far RIGHT arm back. Top1: far RIGHT boot settles flat, near LEFT foot lifts/recovering. Top2: far RIGHT sole supports under hips, near LEFT recovering boot passes forward beside it, arms near neutral. Top3: far RIGHT trailing toe pushes off, near LEFT heel reaches forward airborne; near LEFT arm back, far RIGHT arm forward. Bottom4: near LEFT leading heel contacts, far RIGHT trailing toe still down; near LEFT arm back. Bottom5: near LEFT boot settles flat, far RIGHT foot recovers. Bottom6: near LEFT sole supports under hips, far RIGHT recovering foot passes forward, neutral arms. Bottom7: near LEFT trailing toe pushes off, far RIGHT heel reaches forward airborne, near LEFT arm forward/far RIGHT arm back; subsequent top0 is the new heel contact. Both knees belong to their respective sides of the pelvis, with separate connected shins and boots; no knee/foot swap or same-leg lead in0 and4. Preserve consistent boot shape, buckles and sole material.
The guide's support contacts advance consistently along the same projected ground direction, with all eight handoffs and0-return planned. Its pale heel/toe dots are AUTHORING TARGETS ONLY, never painted dots or proof. Grounded soles must follow this geometry while the opposite foot clears the ground; do not leave both feet airborne. Preserve both complete boots and readable actual lower sole contours so the output can be independently measured. Author all eight coherent full-body poses together. No scenery, tools, floor, shadows, labels, numbers, guide strokes, colored outlines, marker dots, duplicated stance, zoomed cells or poster background. Genuine transparency. One entire wide eight-frame strip. Do not copy the red/yellow fringe pixels on the identity crop. No additional equipment or costume changes.
